subject: E-Commerce
title: Who Wins the Marketplace Wars
description: Learn Who Wins the Marketplace Wars in one minute.

hook.text: No marketplace has ever been permanently dominant. Sears, Yahoo Shopping, and eBay all led and lost. The war never ends.

buildup.text: Each generation brings new platforms: eBay in 2000, Amazon in 2010, TikTok Shop in 2023. Dominance is temporary.

discovery.text: The winning formula changes with technology and culture. Search won before, social wins now, AI may win next.

twist.text: The real winners might be sellers who own their audience. Email lists, brand websites, and direct relationships.

climax.text: Marketplaces come and go. The only permanent strategy is owning your customer relationship, not renting one.

punchline.text: Sears fell, eBay faded, Amazon's turn comes. The only permanent win is owning.

quiz.question: What is the only permanent strategy in the marketplace wars?
options: Owning your customer relationship rather than depending on any single platform
